title: On a class of sharp Sobolev type estimates with weights
summary: We study sharp weighted Sobolev-type inequalities of the form\[ \int_{0}^{1}|u(x)|ρ(x) \,\mathrm{d}x \leqslant Λ \Bigl(\int_{0}^{1}|u^{(k)}(x)|^2 \,\mathrm{d}x \Bigr)^{1/2}, \qquad u\in H_0^k(0,1), \]where $ρ$ is a non-negative weight. We characterize the minimizers and identify the optimal constant $Λ(k,ρ)$ by showing that every minimizer has a constant sign and therefore solves a nonlinear eigenvalue problem of polyharmonic type.
